name: The Westin Tempe
insider_take: Located in the heart of Arizona's innovation corridor, The Westin Tempe sits where desert sophistication meets collegiate energy, just steps from ASU's bustling campus.
whats_special: This modern tower is perfectly positioned in downtown Tempe's Mill Avenue District, offering stunning views of Tempe Butte (known locally as "A" Mountain) and the Salt River. The hotel's rooftop pool provides panoramic desert vistas, while its location puts you within walking distance of ASU Art Museum and the vibrant Mill Avenue Bridge area.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing east for spectacular sunrise views over the Superstition Mountains, and time your visit during ASU's spring training season when the energy is electric.
dont_miss: Take a sunset hike up Tempe Butte (just a 10-minute walk) for Instagram-worthy city views, explore the unique shops along Mill Avenue, and catch a show at the historic Gammage Auditorium, Frank Lloyd Wright's last major work located right on ASU's campus.
pros: Prime location near Arizona State University and Tempe Town Lake
Modern amenities including signature Westin Heavenly Beds
Full-service spa and well-equipped fitness center
Multiple dining options and rooftop pool with city views
cons: Premium pricing typical of upscale chain hotels
Urban setting may lack desert resort ambiance
